tools.name: onesub_setup
tools.description: Analyze the current project and generate onesub integration code. Detects framework (Expo, React Native CLI, bare RN) and generates appropriate setup code.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

tools.name: onesub_add_paywall
tools.description: Generate a customized paywall screen for the app.

title.description: Main headline shown on the paywall (e.g. "Unlock Premium")

features.description: List of benefit strings shown to the user (e.g. ["Unlimited scans", "No ads"])

price.description: Price string displayed to the user (e.g. "$4.99/month")

style.description: Visual style of the paywall screen: 'minimal' (default), 'gradient', or 'card'

tools.name: onesub_check_status
tools.description: Check a user's subscription status via the onesub server.

serverUrl.description: Base URL of the onesub validation server (e.g. "https://api.yourapp.com")

userId.description: The user ID to check subscription status for

tools.name: onesub_troubleshoot
tools.description: Diagnose common IAP issues and provide solutions.

issue.description: Describe the problem (e.g. "Purchase failed", "Receipt validation failed", "Paywall showing for subscribed user")

logs.description: Any relevant error logs or stack traces to help with diagnosis

tools.name: onesub_create_product
tools.description: Create a subscription, consumable, or non-consumable IAP product on Apple App Store Connect and/or Google Play Console. Accepts either appleAppId (numeric) or appleBundleId for Apple. Automatically sets the price and adds Korean localization for KRW products. Use productType to select subscription (default), consumable, or non_consumable.

price.description: Price in the smallest unit (e.g. 499 for $4.99, 4900 for ₩4,900)

productType.description: Product type: subscription (auto-renewable), consumable (can be bought multiple times), or non_consumable (one-time purchase)

period.description: Billing period — only applies to subscriptions

extraRegions.description: Additional region prices, e.g. [{ currency: "KRW", price: 4900 }, { currency: "JPY", price: 600 }]

appleKeyId.description: App Store Connect API Key ID

appleAppId.description: App Store Connect numeric App ID (e.g. "6504191153")

appleBundleId.description: iOS bundle ID (e.g. "gg.pryzm.carrot") — auto-resolves to App ID if appleAppId is not provided

tools.name: onesub_list_products
tools.description: List all IAP products (subscriptions, consumables, non-consumables) registered on Apple App Store Connect and/or Google Play Console

tools.name: onesub_view_subscribers
tools.description: View current subscription status and subscriber count from the onesub server

tools.name: onesub_simulate_purchase
tools.description: Simulate a purchase against a onesub server running in mockMode (started via `npx @onesub/cli dev`). Drives the full validation flow with no real App Store / Play Store credentials — sends a MOCK_* receipt that the server's mock provider decodes into the chosen outcome (new / revoked / expired / invalid / network_error / sandbox). Use to exercise app error paths, verify integration, or drive end-to-end test scenarios from an AI agent.

serverUrl.description: Base URL of the onesub server running in mockMode (default: http://localhost:4100 from `npx @onesub/cli dev`)

userId.description: User ID to associate the purchase with

productId.description: Product ID (arbitrary in mockMode, but must match what your app uses)

scenario.description: Which mock outcome to exercise. Uses MOCK_* receipt prefixes — see docs/RECEIPT-ERRORS.md

tools.name: onesub_simulate_webhook
tools.description: Send a simulated Apple or Google webhook notification to an onesub server to test lifecycle transitions without real store credentials. Builds a fake (unsigned) payload and POSTs it to /onesub/webhook/apple or /onesub/webhook/google. Requires the server to have skipJwsVerification: true (set automatically by `npx @onesub/cli dev`). Apple types: SUBSCRIBED, DID_RENEW, DID_RECOVER, OFFER_REDEEMED, DID_FAIL_TO_RENEW, GRACE_PERIOD_EXPIRED, EXPIRED, REFUND, REVOKE. Google types: purchased, renewed, recovered, restarted, canceled, revoked, expired, on_hold, grace_period, paused, price_change_confirmed.

serverUrl.description: Base URL of the onesub server (default: http://localhost:4100). Apple webhooks require skipJwsVerification: true in the server config (set automatically by `npx @onesub/cli dev`).

notificationType.description:
Notification type to send.
Apple types: SUBSCRIBED, DID_RENEW, DID_RECOVER, OFFER_REDEEMED, DID_FAIL_TO_RENEW, GRACE_PERIOD_EXPIRED, EXPIRED, REFUND, REVOKE
Google types: purchased, renewed, recovered, restarted, canceled, revoked, expired, on_hold, grace_period, paused, price_change_confirmed

transactionId.description: originalTransactionId (Apple) or purchaseToken (Google). Must match an existing record in the server store for the status update to apply.

productId.description: Subscription product ID (Apple: used in signedTransactionInfo; Google: subscriptionId).

subtype.description: Apple only — subtype for DID_FAIL_TO_RENEW. Pass "GRACE_PERIOD" to land in grace_period status; omit for on_hold.

bundleId.description: Apple only — bundle ID embedded in the fake JWS payload.

packageName.description: Google only — package name embedded in the Pub/Sub message.

expiresInDays.description: Apple only — how many days from now to set expiresDate in the fake JWS (default 30). Use a negative number to simulate an already-expired receipt.

tools.name: onesub_inspect_state
tools.description: Read the current subscription + one-time purchase state for a user from the onesub server in one call. Useful after simulating purchases to confirm the server recorded them, or when debugging 'isActive' mismatches.

serverUrl.description: Base URL of the onesub server (default: http://localhost:4100)

tools.name: onesub_manage_product
tools.description: Update or delete an existing IAP product on Apple App Store Connect and/or Google Play Console. Use action="update" to rename a product, or action="delete" to remove it. Note: Apple products that are already approved (READY_FOR_SALE) cannot be deleted via the API — use App Store Connect to remove them manually.

action.description: "update" to rename a product, "delete" to remove it

productId.description: Product ID to update or delete

productType.description: Product type — required to route to the correct API endpoint

name.description: New display name (required for update action)

appleKeyId.description: App Store Connect API Key ID

appleAppId.description: App Store Connect numeric App ID

appleBundleId.description: iOS bundle ID (used to resolve App ID if appleAppId is not provided)
